Chesapeake Bay from Sandy Point to North Beach-
228 AM EDT Mon Oct 12 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH THIS AFTERNOON...

.OVERNIGHT...N winds 10 kt. Gusts up to 20 kt late. Waves 1 to 2 ft.
Showers with a slight chance of tstms. 
.MON...N winds 10 to 15 kt. Gusts up to 25 kt until late afternoon.
Waves 2 ft. Showers.
.MON NIGHT...NW winds 5 kt. Waves less than 1 ft. 
.TUE...SW winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft or less. 
.TUE NIGHT...SW winds 10 to 15 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.WED...SW winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.WED NIGHT...W winds 5 kt...becoming N after midnight. Waves 1 ft. 
.THU...NE winds 10 to 15 kt...becoming SE. Waves 1 to 2 ft. A chance
of showers after midnight. 
.FRI...S winds 15 kt...becoming W 20 to 25 kt in the afternoon, then
becoming NW 25 to 30 kt. Waves 2 to 3 ft... building to 4 ft. A
chance of showers.  

Winds and waves higher and visibilities lower in and near tstms.
